# External derived data

`global_fpv_inventory_2023.csv` is a reproducible transcription of the 643-row
supplement to Nobre et al. (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.solener.2023.112244. Of those
records, 517 contain usable coordinates and 126 remain unlocated. See the JSON
audit and `analysis/extract_global_fpv_inventory.py` for provenance and checks.

This is a survey snapshot through April 2023, not a live or exhaustive 2026
registry. Cite the original paper when reusing the records.
